routes.name: R_OP_SOFT_PARITY
routes.reason: The full-support softened-parity model violates proper-column independence: E[C0 C1]=0 but E[C0]E[C1]=1/64. It is not a manuscript counterexample.

routes.name: Manuscript main-theorem dependency map
routes.note: Mapping only. This mission does not certify the main mixing theorem.

C9000145.statement: Obtain an independently accepted publishable refutation or verification of a substantive manuscript core.
C9000145.remaining: Host-invoked independent mathematical review, statement-fidelity review, and novelty/significance assessment. No campaign-completion claim.

C_OP_CORE.statement: For every k>=3 standard-Borel square with all inherited locality kernels, active projections commute and their intersection has a simultaneous full-coordinate exact-line basis, a compact abelian Haar factor, and unitary edge transport.
C_OP_CORE.remaining: The complete analytic proof is supplied, but is not compiler-checked or independently accepted.
C_OP_CORE.scope: A conditional implication from the square-locality hypotheses; proving the array construction has those hypotheses is a separate node.

C_OP_ACTIVE.statement: Conditional square kernels imply typed rectangle identities, reducing active projections, commutation, and total restricted edge families.
C_OP_ACTIVE.remaining: Independent review of the conditional kernels and essential-range arguments.

C_OP_ALGEBRA.statement: Arbitrary Hilbert-space rectangle square identities, total-family fixed-square constancy and injectivity, and cancellation on dense ranges without bounded inverses.
C_OP_ALGEBRA.mechanical_result: Lean 4.31.0 exit_code=0, axiom_audit_exit_code=0, proof_holes=[]; mechanical evidence recorded on the scoped claim.
C_OP_ALGEBRA.remaining: Independent statement-fidelity approval, not another unchanged compiler run.

C_OP_POLAR.statement: Fixed injective positive parts and polar unitaries normalize into a compact abelian group with Haar law and a measurable corner ratio.
C_OP_POLAR.remaining: Independent review of Fubini, support normalization, compactness and measurability.

C_OP_COMPLETE.statement: All-L2 contraction projection identities and restricted totality imply D_corner=L2(sigma(h)), with no assumed algebra structure on D.
C_OP_COMPLETE.remaining: Independent review of unbounded-input approximation and the reverse inclusion.

C_OP_UNGROUP.statement: Orthogonal exact-line families coincide across all splits; tensor factorization gives full k-coordinate exactness, and partner transport gives unitary edge restrictions.
C_OP_UNGROUP.remaining: Independent review of the all-k tensor argument and the unitary strengthening.

C_OP_FINITE.statement: An exact five-component parity/noise square satisfies all three-cell kernels and has active dimensions 8,4,2; softened parity is rejected for violating proper-plane independence.
C_OP_FINITE.scope: Finite adversarial experiment only; deliberately not an antecedent of C_OP_CORE.

C_OP_SOFT_ADMISSIBLE.statement: Candidate, not a manuscript assertion: the softened parity law with density 1+(sum row parities+sum column parities)/8 has all the inherited square-locality hypotheses.
C_OP_SOFT_ADMISSIBLE.obstruction: Two column parities have joint expectation 0 and individual expectations 1/8, contradicting proper-column independence.
C_OP_SOFT_ADMISSIBLE.remaining: Independent replay of this exact route exclusion; the general verification route remains current.

C_MAIN_MIXING.statement: Every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation is mixing of every finite order, without standardness assumptions.
C_MAIN_MIXING.remaining: All non-operator dependencies and the final implication are unverified here.

C_ZERO_ENTROPY.statement: A least failing order supplies a lower-order-mixing zero-entropy finite-alphabet process and positive centered witness.

C_SATURATION.statement: Every array object has an extension sated for parameter, outside-plane and combined conditional-expectation energies.

C_ROLLED.statement: Rolling the first axis with at most k-2 parent entries gives an admissible extension of a saturated array object.

C_SQUARE_LOCALITY.statement: The saturated array construction supplies the complete parent-screening and ordered grouped square kernels.
C_SQUARE_LOCALITY.remaining: Outside this mission; these kernels are explicit hypotheses of C_OP_CORE.

C_LABEL_BLOCKS.statement: Active exactness, measurable label groups, finite moving blocks and the block witness preserve a nonzero correlation.
C_LABEL_BLOCKS.remaining: Outside this mission, including the separately required parameter geometry.

C_ORBIT_CANCELLATION.statement: Entropy cancellation, orbit alternatives and polynomial cancellation annihilate the projective-character orbit correlations.
C_ORBIT_CANCELLATION.remaining: Outside this mission. Its hypotheses, not this cancellation proposition itself, are supplied by the label-block argument.
